anatomy.flutter: RadioGroup<T>(value, onChanged, children, gap, enabled, invalid, focusNode, label, hint) wraps _RadioScope<T> around Semantics(container:true) -> Column of RadioGroupItem<T> rows; each RadioGroupItem builds SelectionControl(..., semantics: Semantics(inMutuallyExclusiveGroup:true, checked, ...), child: indicator) where the indicator is _Dot (a KeyframePlayer-driven pop) mounted only `checked ? KeyedSubtree(...) : SizedBox.shrink()`.
anatomy.web: RadioGroupPrimitive.Root (data-slot="radio-group", grid w-full gap-2) wraps RadioGroupPrimitive.Item (data-slot="radio-group-item", radioControlClassName) containing RadioGroupPrimitive.Indicator asChild -> RadioIndicator, which renders an inner `anim-change` span only while Radix mounts the indicator (i.e. only when checked).

api.flutter: RadioGroup<T>({value, onChanged, children, gap, enabled=true, invalid=false, focusNode, label, hint}); RadioGroupItem<T>({value, enabled=true, disabledReason, invalid=false, forceFocusRing, label, hint}) — disabledReason is 'Why the item is disabled, shown as a tooltip. Falls back to its own nested FieldScope's.'
api.web: CLOSED: RadioGroupItem now takes disabledReason?: string (components/ui/radio.tsx). When given, the item is wrapped in components/ui/disabled.tsx's Disabled (default native mode — Radix's RadioGroupItem is a real <button disabled>), which adds an always-on aria-describedby plus a click/tap-reachable popover beside the control. ORIGINAL: RadioGroup and RadioGroupItem are thin wrappers over React.ComponentProps<typeof RadioGroupPrimitive.Root/Item> with no radio.tsx-specific props beyond className passthrough — there is no disabledReason prop, no tooltip rendering, and the doc's API Reference table lists only `disabled: boolean — disables this item only` with no explanation mechanism.
api.note: CLOSED 2026-09-11: measured in the dev server (http://localhost:3111, desktop-dark) — focusing a disabled RadioGroupItem with disabledReason set reads the reason via its aria-describedby association; the info button opens a Popover on click/Enter/Space. Pinned by test/radio.test.tsx and e2e/gaps-disabled.spec.ts. ORIGINAL: Flutter's disabledReason (shown as a tooltip, falling back to the item's FieldScope) has no web equivalent anywhere in components/ui/radio.tsx or its doc page — a disabled web radio only gets disabled:opacity-50/cursor-not-allowed with no way to explain why, unlike the Flutter port.

states.flutter: SelectionControl paints fill: checked ? theme.primary : theme.card, border: checked ? theme.primary : theme.input, shadow: checked ? Shadows.controlPrimary : Shadows.inset, and _Dot's KeyframePlayer runs DotSelectionMotion (opacity/scale) fill:'both' so reduced motion lands settled rather than at scale(0); disabled/invalid/forceFocusRing are separate flags threaded into SelectionControl.
states.web: radioControlClassName encodes the same matrix via Radix data-attributes: `data-[state=checked]:border-primary data-[state=checked]:bg-primary data-[state=checked]:shadow-btn-primary`, `focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50`, `aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20`, `disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50`, and RadioIndicator's inner span plays `anim-change` only on real mount (Radix's own behaviour, quoted verbatim in both files' doc comments).

disabled.flutter: enabled is computed from widget.enabled && scope.enabled && (!ownField || field.enabled) && scope.onChanged != null, and SelectionControl receives disabledReason: widget.disabledReason ?? field?.disabledReason so a disabled item can still explain itself via a tooltip.
disabled.web: CLOSED: see the api dimension above — disabledReason is now present on RadioGroupItem, wired through components/ui/disabled.tsx. ORIGINAL: RadioGroupItem just forwards Radix's native `disabled` attribute, styled `disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50`; there is no reason/explanation prop or rendering anywhere in radio.tsx, and the doc's disabled StateCells (`RadioGroupItem value="a" disabled aria-label="Disabled"`) show no explanatory text.
disabled.note: CLOSED 2026-09-11: same fix and evidence as the api dimension. ORIGINAL: Same gap as the api dimension, restated for disabled specifically: a disabled radio on the web communicates only that it cannot be chosen, never why, whereas Flutter's disabledReason gives a tooltip explanation with a FieldScope fallback.

interaction.flutter: _RadioGroupItemState._onKey maps ArrowDown/ArrowRight to step +1 and ArrowUp/ArrowLeft to step -1, delegating to _RadioGroupState.moveFrom which walks only enabled items, wraps with modulo, calls onChanged and focuses the next item's node — a roving tabindex (isTabStop: checked item, else first enabled item) with skipTraversal on every non-stop item.
interaction.web: RadioGroupPrimitive.Root/Item come from radix-ui's RadioGroup, which implements the identical ARIA radiogroup roving-tabindex + arrow-key-selects contract; the Flutter doc comment states this is 'the ARIA radio-group contract Radix implements', i.e. the Dart code is a direct port of Radix's own behaviour.

semantics.flutter: RadioGroup wraps Semantics(container:true, label, hint, enabled) around the group; each RadioGroupItem's SelectionControl attaches Semantics(container:true, inMutuallyExclusiveGroup:true, checked, enabled, label, hint) inside the hit-area expander (per the [HitArea] comment), and RadioGroupItem.size is 20px (_boxSize) with the hit area separately expanded.
semantics.web: radio/page.tsx's Accessibility/Sizes table states the control is 'Drawn at 20px with the same after:-inset-x-3 after:-inset-y-2 hit-area extension as Checkbox, reaching --size-target-min (44px)', matching radioControlClassName's `after:absolute after:-inset-x-3 after:-inset-y-2`; Radix's own Root/Item supply role=radio/radiogroup, aria-checked and roving tabindex natively.
